channel.title: The Argo: the house of nazee.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Kledotos #8870 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Echion made
item.description: Kledotos #8870 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Echion made room at the fire, but no one sat close.

item.title: Kledotos #8870 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus)
item.description: Kledotos #8870 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
